mechanism: Escitalopram is a known QT-prolonging agent, and zoledronic acid may cause electrolyte abnormalities (hypocalcemia) that increase cardiac arrhythmia risk; additionally, both drugs can contribute to CNS effects and potential hyponatremia with SIADH from escitalopram.
action: Monitor ECG and electrolytes (calcium, magnesium, phosphate, sodium) before and after zoledronic acid infusion; assess baseline QT interval and use escitalopram cautiously, considering dose limitations and alternative antidepressants if cardiac risk factors present.
